blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No ticket holder won the ₱265.5-million Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot or the ₱105.81-million Mega Lotto 6/45 jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draws on Monday, Oct. 12, 2026. The Grand Lotto 6/55 draw produced the winning combination 05-41-23-28-20-51, with a jackpot prize of ₱265.5 million. No bettor matched all six numbers. Similarly, the Mega Lotto 6/45 draw yielded the winning combination 03-22-44-13-39-11, with a jackpot of ₱105.81 million. No ticket holder won the top prize.
